pages.text: Chui Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Moyo Asset Managers (SYN). Chui Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to balance income and modest capital growth from fixed income. The management fee of Chui Bond Fund is 1.8 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Chui Bond Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 500. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Chui Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 13.3 percent.

Withdrawals from Chui Bond Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Chui Bond Fund are corporate bonds (55 percent), bond-like fixed deposits (40 percent) and bank bonds (10 percent). SYN Trust Company acts as trustee of Chui Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Chui Bond Fund was launched in 2021 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
